classification_batches_values.name: classification_batches_values
classification_batches_values.value: jsonb_typeof("classification_batches"."items") = 'array' AND jsonb_array_length("classification_batches"."items") BETWEEN 1 AND 100 AND (("classification_batches"."undone_at" IS NULL AND "classification_batches"."undo_reason" IS NULL) OR ("classification_batches"."undone_at" IS NOT NULL AND length(btrim("classification_batches"."undo_reason")) >= 3))

ccb_date_order.name: ccb_date_order
ccb_date_order.value: "credit_card_bills"."closing_date" IS NULL OR "credit_card_bills"."due_date" IS NULL OR "credit_card_bills"."due_date" >= "credit_card_bills"."closing_date"

ccb_closing_period.name: ccb_closing_period
ccb_closing_period.value: "credit_card_bills"."closing_date" IS NULL OR (EXTRACT(MONTH FROM "credit_card_bills"."closing_date") = "credit_card_bills"."month" AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "credit_card_bills"."closing_date") = "credit_card_bills"."year")

ccb_paid_consistency.name: ccb_paid_consistency
ccb_paid_consistency.value: ("credit_card_bills"."paid_at" IS NULL AND "credit_card_bills"."paid_amount" = 0) OR ("credit_card_bills"."paid_at" IS NOT NULL AND "credit_card_bills"."paid_amount" > 0)

external_movement_values.name: external_movement_values
external_movement_values.value: "external_movements"."version" > 0 AND "external_movements"."content_hash" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$' AND ("external_movements"."reviewed_version" IS NULL OR "external_movements"."reviewed_version" BETWEEN 1 AND "external_movements"."version")

financial_event_source_check.name: financial_event_source_check
financial_event_source_check.value: "financial_events"."source" IN ('manual','pdf','android','pluggy') AND "financial_events"."current_version" > 0 AND length("financial_events"."source_scope") > 0 AND length("financial_events"."external_id") > 0 AND "financial_events"."current_hash" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'

integration_job_values.name: integration_job_values
integration_job_values.value: "integration_jobs"."status" IN ('pending','running','completed','failed') AND "integration_jobs"."attempts" >= 0 AND (("integration_jobs"."lease" IS NULL AND "integration_jobs"."lease_expires_at" IS NULL) OR ("integration_jobs"."lease" IS NOT NULL AND "integration_jobs"."lease_expires_at" IS NOT NULL))

purchase_link_active_transaction.name: purchase_link_active_transaction
purchase_link_active_transaction.where: "purchase_ledger_links"."revoked_at" IS NULL AND "purchase_ledger_links"."transaction_id" IS NOT NULL

purchase_link_active_series.name: purchase_link_active_series
purchase_link_active_series.where: "purchase_ledger_links"."revoked_at" IS NULL AND "purchase_ledger_links"."schedule_id" IS NOT NULL AND "purchase_ledger_links"."billing_month" IS NULL

purchase_link_active_occurrence.name: purchase_link_active_occurrence
purchase_link_active_occurrence.where: "purchase_ledger_links"."revoked_at" IS NULL AND "purchase_ledger_links"."schedule_id" IS NOT NULL AND "purchase_ledger_links"."billing_month" IS NOT NULL

purchase_link_period_check.name: purchase_link_period_check
purchase_link_period_check.value: ("purchase_ledger_links"."billing_month" IS NULL AND "purchase_ledger_links"."billing_year" IS NULL) OR ("purchase_ledger_links"."schedule_id" IS NOT NULL AND "purchase_ledger_links"."billing_month" BETWEEN 1 AND 12 AND "purchase_ledger_links"."billing_year" BETWEEN 2000 AND 2200 AND "purchase_ledger_links"."billing_month" IS NOT NULL AND "purchase_ledger_links"."billing_year" IS NOT NULL)

purchase_states_check.name: purchase_states_check
purchase_states_check.value: "purchase_observations"."amount_meaning" IN ('purchase_total','installment','unknown') AND "purchase_observations"."kind" IN ('purchase','refund') AND "purchase_observations"."confirmation" IN ('observed','pending','posted','retracted') AND "purchase_observations"."review" IN ('unreviewed','needs_review','accepted','ignored')

purchase_installments_check.name: purchase_installments_check
purchase_installments_check.value: ("purchase_observations"."installment_number" IS NULL AND "purchase_observations"."total_installments" IS NULL) OR ("purchase_observations"."installment_number" IS NOT NULL AND "purchase_observations"."total_installments" IS NOT NULL AND "purchase_observations"."installment_number" BETWEEN 1 AND "purchase_observations"."total_installments" AND "purchase_observations"."total_installments" BETWEEN 1 AND 120)

tx_bill_payment_unique.name: tx_bill_payment_unique
tx_bill_payment_unique.where: domain_type = 'bill_payment' AND is_reversed = false AND billing_year IS NOT NULL

tx_materialized_unique.name: tx_materialized_unique
tx_materialized_unique.where: scheduled_transaction_id IS NOT NULL AND is_reversed = false

tx_classification_values.name: tx_classification_values
tx_classification_values.value: "transactions"."classification_source" IN ('unreviewed','manual','rule') AND "transactions"."economic_responsibility" IN ('unknown','own','family','work','property') AND ("transactions"."classification_confidence" IS NULL OR "transactions"."classification_confidence" IN ('exact','ambiguous')) AND (("transactions"."classification_source" = 'unreviewed' AND "transactions"."classification_reviewed_at" IS NULL) OR ("transactions"."classification_source" <> 'unreviewed' AND "transactions"."classification_reviewed_at" IS NOT NULL)) AND (("transactions"."classification_rule_id" IS NULL AND "transactions"."classification_rule_version" IS NULL AND "transactions"."classification_source" <> 'rule') OR ("transactions"."classification_rule_id" IS NOT NULL AND "transactions"."classification_rule_version" > 0 AND "transactions"."classification_source" = 'rule'))

budgets_values.name: budgets_values
budgets_values.value: "budgets"."month" BETWEEN 1 AND 12 AND "budgets"."year" BETWEEN 2000 AND 2200 AND "budgets"."currency" = 'BRL' AND "budgets"."limit_amount" > 0 AND "budgets"."version" > 0 AND "budgets"."economic_scope" IN ('all','own','family','work','property')
